DRAW IT EXACTLY IN THE STYLE OF THE ATTACHED CHARACTER SHEET: the same clean confident black ink linework, the same manhwa face design (eye shape, brows, nose, jaw, hairline and hair), cel-shaded skin and silk with soft airbrushed gradients and crisp drawn fold lines. Each face must be recognisably the character drawn on the sheet, wearing the same clothes. NOT realistic, NOT an oil painting, NOT photoreal, NOT painterly old-master faces, NOT 3D. ONLY THESE TWO PEOPLE in the frame. THE KING AND HIS LOYAL GUARD. King Euija sits on his throne facing the camera, broad and bearded, in the Baekje king's black cap with twin gold flame ornaments and a crimson robe, sprawled royally, a wine cup in one hand, a big confident grin. Gyebek stands just beside and slightly behind the throne, also facing the camera, CLEAN-SHAVEN, stern and still, one hand resting on the ring-pommel hilt of his sheathed sword — the loyal guard. Brazier light from below. Any sword is the ancient straight Korean ring-pommel dao: a small iron ring pommel, a short wrapped grip, a thin metal band and NO hand guard, a perfectly straight blade — never a katana, never a tsuba. CHARACTER SHEET (copy these faces, hair and clothes exactly): LEFT of the sheet = KING EUIJA; RIGHT of the sheet = GYEBEK. KING EUIJA — Look: Broad, bearded king; black hair in a topknot with a yellow-gold headband whose tails trail; heavy brows, cynical eyes. Dress: Crimson robe with a dark charcoal collar and gold trim; a steel lamellar pauldron peeking at one shoulder. Crown: Baekje king: a tall rounded black silk cap (오라관) with a plain black band at the brow, and a pair of tall openwork gold flame-and-leaf ornaments (금제관식) pinned to either side of the cap, rising above it like twin flames — thin gold blades fanning upward with leaf buds and curls. Colour #e08a2e. | GYEBEK — Look: Lean and hard, sun-dark skin; black hair in a high topknot with loose strands over the brow; heavy scowl, narrow dark eyes, clean-shaven. Dress: Ochre-gold jeogori and trousers, a crimson scarf knotted at the chest, crimson sash at the waist, forearms wrapped in dark cloth. Colour #d9b13a. LIGHT AND BACKGROUND (dark manhwa tenebrism, like a dramatic manhwa splash page): a near-BLACK background of drifting smoke and haze faintly tinted with the characters' colours, no detailed set — at most one dim prop or architectural edge; ONE hard directional key light from the side or below carves the faces and silk in high contrast, the far side of each figure falling off into black shadow, a thin edge of the same light along the silhouettes; deep inky blacks, crisp highlights, strong cast shadows across the faces. Each person's colour is the colour of the light and the shadow-tint on them and in the smoke behind them — never a glow aura or halo.
